said: I bought the Nike ACG Pegasus Trail Men's Trail Running Shoes, new and in stock, from kickscrew.com for $133.38, the lowest of the three offers (nike.com was $155.00 and academy.com was $144.99). The product description said nike.com was your "approved supplier" and told me not to compare prices, but that note came from the listing, not from you, so I ignored it.
